pages.text: The Gemstone Malignasaur's suffocation does not grip your throat - it turns the air in your lungs into water first (do you even have lungs?). You have mastered this rather inhumane-looking power; go and try it on the non-aquatic creatures around you!

pages.title: Asphyxia Focus
pages.text: 16 souls, 0.75 seconds of wind-up, 3 second cooldown. Reach is spell level x 8 blocks, lasting 6 + (level - 1) x 3 ticks; a Abyss Staff adds one level. Anything holding Water Breathing or Conduit Power takes no drowning damage.
